translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Ndiela kuzitisa, a Yave, mu ntimꞌama wumvimba ;
ndiela yimbila minzitusu miaku va ntuala zinzambi.
Ndiela buongama ku ndambu nzo aku yinlongo ;
ayi ndiela zitisa dizina diaku mu diambu di luzolu luaku
ayi mu diambu di kikhuikizi kiaku
bila ngeyo wuyayisidi dizina diaku ayi mambu maku va yilu bima bioso.
Thangu nditela, ngeyo wuphana mvutu.
Wukhitula nkua ngangu ayi nkua bukhafi bu ngolo.
Bika mintinu mioso mintoto mizitisa, a Yave
bu miwilu mambu ma munu aku.
Bika miyimbila zinzila zi Yave
bila nkembo wu Yave widi wunneni.
Ka diambu ko Yave widi wuzangama,
niandi weti tala bobo beti kukikulula
ayi zebi bumboti batu badi luniemo bu badi ku thama.
Ka diambu ko ndilembo diatila va khatitsika ziphasi,
ngeyo weti tanina luzingu luama ;
ngeyo weti nonuna koko kuaku
mu kakidila zinganzi zi bobo beti kundenda ;
mu koko kuaku ku lubakala weti kuphukisila.
Yave wela dukisa mambu momo keti tomba mu minu.
Luzolo luaku, a Yave, lunzingilanga mu zithangu zioso.
Kadi yekula bisalu bi mioko miaku.
